title: Families of curves separating points
summary: We show that for a hyperbolic curve X over an algebraically closed field k of characteristic zero and a finite set S of k-rational points of X, after replacing X by a finite étale cover, there exists a family of curves over X whose fibres over points in S have pairwise nonisogenous Jacobians. We also give an application of our results to a problem concerning Galois sections.
